testDefinitions.notes: Visual examination: clear, syrupy liquid at 25 °C. Substance may partly or totally solidify at room temperature and liquefies again when heated to 50 °C (source: Liquid Glucose__Liquid Glucose - SM.txt:32).
Dissolve 0.1 g in 2.5 mL water, heat with 2.5 mL cupri-tartaric solution; a red precipitate is formed (source: Liquid Glucose__Liquid Glucose - SM.txt:32).

Dip stick with reactive pad (glucose-oxidase, peroxidase, tetramethylbenzidine) for 1 s in 5 g/L solution of substance; within 60 s color changes from yellow to green or blue (source: Liquid Glucose__Liquid Glucose - SM.txt:32).
Alternative identification method per BP: absorption maximum of the solution lies between 325 nm and 327 nm (source: Vitamim A Palmitat__Vitamim A Palmitate-SM.txt:30).

testDefinitions.displayName: Assay of Vitamin A Palmitate (UV spectrophotometry)
testDefinitions.notes: 82.44 mg in pentane/2-propanol, measure A326 and spectral purity ratios (A300/A326 NMT 0.60, A350/A326 NMT 0.54, A370/A326 NMT 0.14). Content (IU/g) = A326 x V x 1900 / (100 x m). Limit 95.0-110.0 % of stated amount (1.7 IU/mg = 1,700,000 IU/g). Measurement test, analyst enters final % of stated amount (multi-wavelength ratio and IU conversion not calculated by UV workflow; source: Vitamim A Palmitat__Vitamim A Palmitate-SM.txt:33).

Exists only so the not-applicable record can name it; no specification rows. Not-applicable justification: Reference CRS not available; alternative UV identification method used (source: Vitamim A Palmitat__Not applicable For Vitamin A Palmitate.txt:2; Vitamim A Palmitat__Vitamim A Palmitate-SM.txt:30).

solutions.name: 0.05 M Edetate Disodium VS
solutions.instructions: Dissolve 18.6 g of edetate disodium in water to make 1000 mL. Standardize against standard calcium carbonate (~200 mg) dissolved in dilute HCl, diluted to 100 mL, pH 12-13 with sodium hydroxide TS, with hydroxy naphthol blue indicator to blue endpoint.
solutions.notes: Recipe from STM: 18.6 g in 1000 mL water. Standardized against calcium carbonate (1 mL 0.05 M EDTA = 5.0045 mg CaCO3; 100.09 x 0.05 = 5.0045). House defaults: 3 replicates, factor 0.97-1.03, max RSD 0.2 %, valid 30 days, shelf life 30 days.
